does_not_establish: a covariant action or conserved stress-energy
finite six-ray transport as a rotation-independent physical prediction
establishes: The proposed disk-normal directionality was absent as an exact executable formula from the current registry.
A dimensionally closed source-drift-diffusion-absorption law and two same-state observable maps are now executable.
A distinct directional carrier phase-space law is executable and its Q, F, and P angular moments are not conflated.
The macroscopic disk-polar law is labeled a moment closure of the kinetic law rather than a second independent empirical theory.
A standard control prevents a stationary field from being mislabeled as continuous GR radiation.
The positivity-preserving six-ray Markov fixture derives the DPEL diffusion eigenvalues at moment level while retaining its higher-angular discretization failure.
The law has exact isotropic, spherical, zero-source, rotation, absorption, and polar/equatorial falsifiers.
An existing public three-galaxy source bundle can drive a response-blind source-only replay.

kinetic_parent_law.diffusion_relation: DPEL01 is the declared optically thick moment limit of the executable disk-aligned odd angular modes: D_parallel_eff=c^2/(3 kappa_parallel), D_perp_eff=c^2/(3 kappa_perp). It is not an exact rewrite away from that limit; finite-closure errors remain separately testable.
kinetic_parent_law.disk_aligned_collision: The six-ray closure fixture uses +/-e1,+/-e2,+/-n and a positivity-preserving Markov generator C_a=kappa_base(Q-f_a)+r_axis(f_opposite(a)-f_a), where kappa_base=min(kappa_axis) and r_axis=(kappa_axis-kappa_base)/2. It conserves Q, has nonnegative off-diagonal transition rates, and damps each odd axis mode at kappa_axis. The two in-plane pairs use kappa_parallel=c^2/(3 D_parallel_eff); the normal pair uses kappa_perp=c^2/(3 D_perp_eff), with D_axis_eff=(1-A_D)D_iso+A_D D_axis.
kinetic_parent_law.drift_transport: The common carrier velocity includes v_g=-chi grad(rho_b/rho_star), so the zeroth moment contains div(Q v_g) rather than inserting drift only after closure.
kinetic_parent_law.finite_angular_boundary: The six-ray program is a positivity/moment-closure fixture only. Its second moment and resulting diffusion tensor are SO(3)-covariant, but its fourth and higher angular moments depend on the in-plane discretization. DGKT01 finite-transport response prediction is SOURCE_BLOCKED until an angularly converged positive solver passes rotation tests; DPEL01 macroscopic response synthesis may proceed separately.
kinetic_parent_law.moments: Q=sum_a w_a f_a; F_g=c sum_a w_a Omega_a f_a; P_g=c^2 sum_a w_a Omega_a Omega_a f_a
kinetic_parent_law.quantum_boundary: If a carrier quantum is introduced, E=hbar omega and p=hbar k. The package assumes no fixed minimum carrier energy, no Planck-pixel claim, and no ontology score from Q or F alone.
kinetic_parent_law.state: f_g(x,Omega,t) >= 0 is a grey directional population per unit solid-angle weight; it is a speculative load carrier and is not identified with an on-shell GR graviton.
kinetic_parent_law.static_gr_control: A time-independent mass quadrupole has zero radiative second derivative and is not treated as continuously emitting GR gravitational waves. GR radiation and the speculative load carrier are separate cards.

law.baryonic_shape: Compute the mass-weighted second-moment tensor C about the barycenter. The unit eigenvector n of its smallest eigenvalue is the disk normal. A_D=clip(1-3*lambda_min/trace(C),0,1) switches the directional tensor off for a sphere.
law.boundary_condition: Target-free solver uses a periodic conservative box with source support exponentially small at the boundary; an empirical galaxy solver must use an independently converged isolated/open boundary.
law.diffusion_tensor: D_iso=(2 D_parallel + D_perp)/3; D=(1-A_D) D_iso I + A_D[D_parallel(I-n n^T)+D_perp n n^T]
law.evolution: partial_t U_Q=-div(U_Q v_g)+div(D grad U_Q)+4 pi G kappa_s D_iso rho_b-[Gamma_0+beta rho_b/rho_star]U_Q
law.photon_path_observable: Delta ln(1+z)_path=(eta_Q/c) integral U_Q/c^2 d ell
law.source_domain_rule: The normal and activation are computed from the connected baryonic component inside one predeclared segmentation/window. Changing that window is a new formula version, not a nuisance fit.
law.state: U_Q(x,t) >= 0, an extra gravitational potential depth with SI dimension L^2 T^-2

registered_parameterization.empirical_rule: Before response access, freeze either these values or a target-free grid and one selection rule; no per-object D_parallel, D_perp, chi, beta, kappa_s, or eta_Q.

source_and_response_preflight.first_response_test: On a frozen development subset, compare the unchanged polar-escape law with Newton, baryons+NFW, RAR, AQUAL, QUMOND, Refracted Gravity, published nonlocal gravity, and isotropic-GQNS using independent full 2D velocity fields. The sharp orientation test is a matched high-inclination disk sample comparing polar/off-plane tracers or lensing with in-plane predictions at fixed baryonic source.

published_source_anchors.role: H I source and future independent velocity field

source_and_response_preflight.real_shaped_synthetic_first_pass: Before opening velocity or lensing responses, use the exact three-galaxy source grids, masks, spatial sampling, covariance design, inclination ranges, and planned nuisance priors to generate null, DPEL01, isotropic-load, Newton+NFW, RAR, AQUAL, QUMOND, Refracted-Gravity, and published-nonlocal injections. Require blind recovery, null calibration, cross-formula confusion matrices, parameter-boundary recovery, and held-out geometry transfer. DGKT01 finite-transport injections remain blocked until a positive angularly converged solver passes rotation tests. Freeze survivors and thresholds before real-response scoring.
